correctness.rationale: For n>=2, 1<=k<n, complementation reduces to s=min(k,n-k)<=n/2. Exactly s positive hypotheses at any root bound complete depth by 1+floor(log2 s); two length-2^r center blocks on opposite root branches and arbitrary prefix tests supply a matching full binary tree. The VC proof establishes no triple is shattered and an adjacent pair is shattered for s>=2, with singleton/complement cases s=1. Explicit program replay, 120 all-k direct finite minimax cases, 10 larger finite minimax cases, 190 VC trace cases and 6 full-path tree certificates passed. Finite checks supplement, rather than replace, the uniform proof.

value.rationale: The natural fixed-length cyclic-arc incidence family has a precise yet previously unlocated online rank law controlled by the shorter arc. It gives every finite parameter, a constructive optimal adversarial tree, and exact characterization of when n concepts meet their cardinality-limited maximum depth. Its VC dimension stays at most two while its optimal deterministic online mistake bound diverges with s; this sharp gap is mathematically motivated without requiring a downstream paper-sized theorem.
